engineering_objective: Repair the inherited Go catalog plane so snapshot isolation, commit-time constraints, secondary indexes, WAL-decoded logical CDC, LSN/epoch-fenced replica apply, and checkpoint redo agree after the bounce.
required_end_state: Operator workflows through /app/catalog/bin/catalogctl satisfy the binding catalog contract for visibility, commit durability, constraints, indexes, decode, apply, recover, CLI usage errors, and health/apply/rejects/cdc report schemas while leaving the warehouse dump untouched.
functional_requirements: Drive all operator work through /app/catalog/bin/catalogctl against the Go catalog plane and WAL protocol.
Unknown flags or unknown commands exit 2 before any WAL, heap, index, replica, or slot mutation.
commit requires --input; missing --input exits 2 without opening a transaction.
--reset-output may clear /app/catalog/out only and must not truncate WAL, heap, indexes, checkpoint, replica, slot, or warehouse.

Snapshot isolation, commit-after-WAL heap/index install, CDC decode from committed WAL, LSN/epoch-fenced FK-ordered apply, and checkpoint redo of committed records follow /app/catalog/docs/catalog-contract.md.
Constraint failures fail closed with rejects.jsonl and WAL ABORT without heap/index install.
Secondary indexes rebuild from committed-visible heap after successful COMMIT and after recover.
decode emits committed WAL mutations only, in WAL LSN order, with update before/after images when present.
apply rejects a whole batch on epoch mismatch without advancing confirmed_lsn; skips already-confirmed LSNs; applies remaining records in FK order within a txn.
recover restores from checkpoint, redos only committed WAL beyond checkpoint.lsn, does not bump replica epoch, and rebuilds indexes.
inspect and empty-check rewrite /app/catalog/out/health.json from observed state and must not recover, decode-apply, bump epoch, or append WAL.
Successful operator commands rewrite health.json with the contracted fields and semantics.
preservation_requirements: Keep the existing Go catalog plane; do not move catalog logic into another language or abandon the WAL protocol.
safety_requirements: Usage errors exit 2 without durable mutation of WAL/heap/indexes/replica/slot.
Stale-epoch CDC batches apply nothing and do not advance confirmed_lsn.
Uncommitted WAL records are not installed by recover and are not emitted by decode.

required_outputs.notes: Contracted health schema after successful operator commands.
CDC decode output; committed WAL mutations only.
applied, skipped, rejected, confirmed_lsn, epoch integers.
Constraint reject objects on failed commits.
sku_code and offer_code maps with tenant_id\\0code keys.
Checkpoint with durable lsn and committed heap identity.

current_state_claims: After the bounce, snapshot reads, constraints, indexes, WAL-decoded CDC, replica apply, and checkpoint redo disagree even though quiet commits still succeed.
Shift notes and bounce log remain under /app/catalog/notes and /app/catalog/logs.
